### Incident Scenario Title
A concise, realistic production incident title (e.g. "Kafka Consumer Group Rebalance Storm").

### Career Track Focus
- [ ] Cloud Engineer & SRE
- [ ] Software Developer
- [ ] Data Analyst

### Production Scenario & Triage Context
Describe the production alerts, telemetry metrics, and symptoms observed during on-call triage.

### Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
What caused the incident at the systems/code level?

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) & Resolution
What steps and commands/configs should the candidate practitioner execute to resolve the issue?

### Key Core Concepts / Rubric Keywords
List 4-5 essential technical terms (e.g., `max.poll.interval.ms`, `heartbeat`, `rebalance`).
